description: Search You.com documentation and help resources using the specialized docs MCP server. Provides targeted search within You.com's documentation, guides, and support materials.

parsed_description.main: Search You.com documentation, API guides, and help resources for specific information.
parsed_description.args: query: The documentation search query. section: Optional specific documentation section to search within.
parsed_description.returns: DocsSearchResponse object containing relevant documentation pages with titles, URLs, and content excerpts
parsed_description.raises: You.com docs API errors for invalid queries or service issues
